proposal.reason: Primary change is in transport connection setup and P2P wiring: transport selection/progress reporting, host-device stream synchronization during connect, and P2P setup/teardown behavior in src/transport.cc and src/transport/p2p.cc. Additional memory review is needed because the PR introduces new shared-memory handle/descriptor lifecycle (allocate/import/close, refcount/unlink, mmap/register ownership) across src/include/shm.h, src/misc/shmutils.cc, and src/transport/shm.cc.
